gloss: long and short; pros and cons

definitions.explanation: The contrast between long and short; various lengths.

definitions.gloss: strengths and weaknesses; pros and cons
definitions.explanation: Good points and bad points; advantages and disadvantages.

examples.japanese: {棒|ぼう}の{長短|ちょうたん}を{比|くら}べる。
examples.english: To compare the lengths of sticks.

examples.japanese: どんな{方法|ほうほう}にも{長短|ちょうたん}がある。
examples.english: Every method has its pros and cons.

examples.japanese: {長短|ちょうたん}さまざまな{鉛筆|えんぴつ}がある。
examples.english: There are pencils of various lengths.

notes:
{長短|ちょうたん} combines {長|ちょう} (long) and {短|たん} (short). It can describe physical length or metaphorical strengths and weaknesses.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {長短|ちょうたん}がある: to have pros and cons
- {一長一短|いっちょういったん}: having both merits and demerits

cross_references.headword: {一長一短|いっちょういったん}
